sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pad(fr): return [l.ljust(64,'B') for l in fr.split('\n')][:64]
def pos(fr, ch):
    a=pad(fr); rs=[r for r in range(12,50) for c in range(10,50) if a[r][c]==ch]
    return (min(rs),max(rs)) if rs else None
def snap(fr):
    return {c:pos(fr,c) for c in 'MRbN'}
def hud(fr):
    a=pad(fr); return [a[r][28:48] for r in range(56,61)]
base=snap(current_frame.ascii); print('before', base, 'hud', hud(current_frame.ascii))
# Test 1: MOUSE on red center (26,43)
r1=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':43}])
s1=snap(current_frame.ascii)
print('after MOUSE', s1, 'changed', s1!=base, 'res', last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
if s1==base:
    r2=action(['ACTION7'])
    s2=snap(current_frame.ascii)
    print('after ACTION7', s2, 'changed', s2!=base, 'res', last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
print('hud now', hud(current_frame.ascii))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
